card.name: Mixed: digits of 40/4.9 and linking words
card.fires_on: Responds to a few unrelated spots: the first digit 4 or the decimal point inside numbers like 4.9 years or 40 mg, and a linking word such as to or would right after a subject in narrative text.

modes.label: Inside numbers
modes.description: The digit 4 or the decimal point inside numbers such as 4.9 years or 40 mg, especially statin dosing and trial text.

modes.label: Linking word in narrative
modes.description: The word to or would right after a subject, leading into a goal or expected outcome in a story or biography.
modes.example: he hoped this collection<< would>> cement his reputation.

card.plain: It fires on the digit 4 in numbers like 40 mg or 4.9 years, and also on small words like to and would in stories.
